body:
Real, editable 'Resume' panel in CarePyre's console.html -- hidden sidebar nav item (shown only when effective_permissions includes community-tools.access, server-enforced too). Real Basics fields, real dynamic add/remove Work Experience and Education entry lists (matching JSON Resume's own real array shape), Save (PUT) + Verify (POST .../verify) with a real, itemized per-rule report, never a single opaque score. Real, live-found correctness issue fixed before shipping: entry-row values were first drafted via string-concatenated innerHTML spliced into value="..." attributes -- esc() only escapes for text content, not attribute-breaking double-quotes a real field (quoted job title, apostrophe in a name) could contain. Fixed by building inputs via document.createElement + setting .value as a real DOM property, no HTML parsing involved. JS syntax verified (node --check), HTML div balance verified (119/119) -- this repo has no build/test pipeline for static HTML, named as the honest limit of what got checked; no live browser click-through was run. docs/COMMUNITY_TOOLS_RESUME_NORTHSTAR.md + CLAUDE.md updated. Commit d9e1a1f.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Resume/CV builder + verifier frontend panel in console.html
